records.explanation: Using the latest version of each deal, the lost deals add up to 781,300 in expected revenue.
records.sql:
SELECT SUM(expected_revenue) AS total_lost_expected_revenue
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (deal_id) deal_id, expected_revenue, is_lost
  FROM staging.stg_deals
  ORDER BY deal_id, source_version DESC
) d
WHERE is_lost;

records.explanation: 53 won deals have been invoiced and have nothing open, with payments covering the full invoiced amount.
records.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.deal_id) AS won_fully_paid_deals
FROM marts.deal_to_cash d
JOIN staging.stg_deals s ON s.deal_id = d.deal_id
WHERE s.is_won
  AND d.invoiced > 0
  AND d.open = 0
  AND d.paid >= d.invoiced;

records.explanation: After subtracting credit notes from invoices, Maple Street Bakery has the highest net billing at 178,520.
records.sql:
SELECT customer_key, customer_name,
       SUM(CASE WHEN move_type = 'out_refund' THEN -ABS(amount) ELSE ABS(amount) END) AS net_billed
FROM intermediate.int_invoices
WHERE move_type IN ('out_invoice', 'out_refund')
GROUP BY customer_key, customer_name
ORDER BY net_billed DESC
LIMIT 1;
